newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese, Italian watchdogs to swap information.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese, Italian watchdogs to swap information.

text.p: The Portuguese and Italian financial markets watchdogs signed an agreement to exchange information between the two institutions.

"The importance of the agreement is to reinforce the cooperation that exists between the two commissions and to develop our channels of communication at various levels," the president of Portugal's Securities Exchange Commission (CMVM), Jose Nunes Pereira, told Reuters.
The agreement was signed in Lisbon by Nunes Pereira and Enzo Berlana, president of Italy's National Bourse Commission (CONSOB).
The CMVM has already signed similar cooperation agreements with the financial markets committees of Spain, Belgium, France and Brazil.
